name: Spine Stretch Forward
description: Sitting tall with your legs apart, round forward from the top of your head as if over a ball, reaching forward, then stack back up.

source.title: Spine Stretch Forward on the Mat (Online Pilates Classes)
source.note: Classic Pilates mat exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Sit tall with your legs straight and a little wider than your hips, feet flexed.
Arms reach forward at shoulder height.
cues: Start the curl with your head, then your upper back.
Keep your hips still on the mat.
Breathe out as you round forward; rebuild the spine as you breathe in.

prescription.note: Move with your breath, slowly and with control.

keyframes.name: Round forward
keyframes.cue: Curl forward, reaching past your feet.
